title: [review] lichend.rs: Epoch counter wraps to zero, breaking replay prote
description: `epoch.wrapping_add(1)` wraps 255 -> 0. Although epochs < 128 are bumped to 128 on load, the sequence 254 -> 255 -> 0 -> 128 is non-monotonic across reboots. If epochs are used for anti-replay (likely given the context), an attacker could replay messages from epoch > 128 after wrap.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed wrapping_add(1) to saturating_add(1) to prevent epoch wrap 255->0->128. Added warning when epoch saturates at 255 to alert operators to re-key.
